findings.summary: The proposed render check in the Compose job compares six values for each render, not the whole rendered file with main's, so a changed default of another variable would pass it.
A STACK_PROJECT with a trailing space or capitals is not refused by the test; Compose itself refuses such a project name.
No test pins the defaults of STACK_APP_PORT, STACK_PROXY_PORT, STACK_IMAGE and STACK_PGDATA_DIR; changing one (for example the app port to 8001) passes every rule.
Nothing stops a fixed name: on the stack network, which would make two stacks share one network despite different project names.
